what: Time of a conversion from the release of the ligand, for every run, by the rule of md/PLAN.md (entry of 7 Oct 2026, 12:10 AM IST, point 1). Read from the column `state` of timeseries_equil_solute.csv (stages 4, 5, 6) and timeseries_solute.csv of both programs.

rule.assigned_state: the state of the frame if C or R, else that of the frame before; before the first joined frame the state of the start (specification, section 4)
rule.time: first frame of the first long visit in the opposite state, counted from the start of stage 4
